description: The Democratic staff of the U.S. Congress Joint Economic Committee (JEC) seeks a research assistant to work closely with policy advisors, economists and other senior staff on a range of economic issues. A successful candidate will have broad knowledge of the field of economics, have technical experience using spreadsheets to analyze economic data and also be detail-oriented. Duties will include providing research assistance for reports, assisting in hearing preparation and fact checking Committee publications, including charts, hearing memos, floor statements, reports and materials for social media. A Bachelor's degree in Economics, Public Policy or a related field is required. Capitol Hill experience is a plus. Salary commensurate with experience. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume to dems@jec.senate.gov with "Research Assistant" in the subject line. Applicants who are called for an interview will be asked to submit a short writing sample and a list of references. The Joint Economic Committee is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, disability, national origin, uniformed service, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression.

description: The Joint Committee on Taxation is seeking an entry level IT support professional to join our Information Technology staff in a Desktop Support role. The Desktop Support Technician provides support to end users on a wide range of issues by identifying, researching, and resolving technical problems. A day in the Desktop Support life may include: Responding to all inquiries for technical support same day or next business day while documenting, tracking, and monitoring all issues to ensure a timely resolution. Installing or supporting desktop applications, PC & printer hardware, and mobile devices such as iPhones and iPads. Creating new users and setting up workstations for new staff. Maintaining IT equipment and printer supply. Providing support and responding to issues for staff working remotely.
responsibilities: Respond to all inquiries for technical support same day or next business day while documenting, tracking, and monitoring all issues to ensure a timely resolution
Install or support PC & printer hardware
Install or support mobile devices such as iPhones and iPads
Create new users and set up workstations for new staff
Maintain IT equipment and printer supply

qualifications: Associates degree in information technology or certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Certified IT Professional (MCITP) or the equivalent
Strong technical background with a broad range of technologies including Active Directory
Strong technical background with Desktop Windows OS 7 - 10
Strong technical background with Hardware Setup and Configuration (Computers, Printers, Etc.)
Strong technical background with general networking knowledge
Strong technical background with MS Office
Strong technical background with Mac OS
Strong technical background with Mobile Devices including iOS
A person of the highest character and probity
how_to_apply: Email resume to it.jobs@jct.gov by October 24, 2016.

description: Connecticut Democrat seeks qualified candidates for DC Scheduler in team-oriented office. Responsibilities include maintaining member's daily and long term schedule in Washington, evaluating meeting requests and invitations, coordinating travel arrangements, managing member's personal correspondence, and ensuring timely preparation for the member for meetings and events. The ideal candidate for this position is detail oriented and proactive, possess strong communication skills, and can thrive in a fast paced and team oriented office. Prior scheduling experience is preferred, as are Connecticut ties and access to a car. Please submit a resume and cover letter to CT02JOB@mail.house.gov. No calls or drop-ins.
